role: Content-addressed preservation of the review manifests named by canon-acceptances.v1.json. The acceptance ledger is append-only and digest-bound and was NOT mutated; this is a sidecar that binds each ledgered digest to a retained body.
finding: Owner ruling 3 anticipated that one manifest body would already be unrecoverable. BOTH survived. Each was recovered from its /tmp path and its sha256 recomputed from the retained bytes; both match the digest the acceptance ledger recorded at acceptance time, so neither had to be reconstructed and nothing is recorded as unrecoverable.
defect_being_remediated: canon-impact --accept recorded review_manifest as a volatile /tmp path. A manifest that cannot be produced later cannot substantiate the review it attests. Future acceptances must retain the manifest body under this directory and record its content address, never a mutable path.
